definitions.explanation: the process of converting information, processes, or services into digital format

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}のデジタル{化|か}を{進|すす}める。
examples.english: To promote the digitization of documents.

examples.japanese: {行政|ぎょうせい}サービスのデジタル{化|か}が{遅|おく}れている。
examples.english: The digitalization of government services is lagging behind.

examples.japanese: デジタル{化|か}によって{業務|ぎょうむ}{効率|こうりつ}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: Work efficiency has improved through digitalization.

JAPAN CONTEXT:
{デジタル庁|でじたるちょう} (Digital Agency) was established in 2021 to promote digitalization of government services. The COVID-19 pandemic highlighted Japan's relative lag in digital adoption.
